model.description: Legacy field: requested/execution model id. Prefer requested_model_id when present.

model_snapshot.description: Legacy field: dated snapshot only when explicitly declared. Null for alias-only requests even if a CLI default snapshot label exists. Prefer declared_model_snapshot when present.

requested_model_id.description: Model id requested for execution (alias or dated snapshot id).

declared_model_snapshot.description: Dated snapshot declared by the operator or implied by requesting the dated model id. Null when only the alias was requested without an explicit snapshot declaration.

provider_verified_model_id.description: Provider-confirmed model id from a live response when available. Remains null for dry-run and when the provider does not return one. Never invent this value.

generation_completed.description: True only when a local image was successfully persisted from recognized API output. Dry-run and URL-only/incomplete outputs are false.

creative_provenance.description: Optional recipe-origin provenance (PR-CR-002). Required only for records that claim PromptRecipe origin. Hash consistency is not independent provider-origin proof.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of receipt compilation.prompt (compiler form; may include trailing newline).

adapter_prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the adapter-effective prompt (compiler prompt after documented strip). Must match generation metadata prompt_sha256.

recipe_receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the full compile_recipe receipt object.
